label: Image Collage
description: Packs any set of photos into a designed contact sheet: a searched layout with hero, portrait and panorama cells sized to each image's aspect, even pixel gutters, and a soft crop budget so nothing is trimmed too hard. Big sets page into one PNG per sheet. With no images it shows a demo set.

sourceIds.label: Images
sourceIds.description: Images to pack — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. Empty renders a built-in demo set so you can preview the layout before adding photos.

gutter.label: Gutter
gutter.description: Space between images, as a fraction of the canvas short edge.

margin.label: Margin
margin.description: Outer margin as a fraction of the gutter — 1 matches the gutter, 0 runs the images to the canvas edge.

cropBudget.label: Crop budget
cropBudget.description: How much of an image the cover-crop may trim. Soft — exceeded minimally when nothing else fits.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the layout search's taste tie-breaks (which images become heroes, band rhythm). Same seed → same layout.

maxImagesPerSheet.label: Max per sheet
maxImagesPerSheet.description: Images per sheet. Sets larger than this page into a multi-file pipeline (one PNG per page). 30 is a tuned default.

pageLattice.label: Page lattice
pageLattice.description: Paged sets: "uniform" shares one mix-fitted lattice across pages (a designed set); "independent" re-searches per page (best per-page crops).

background.label: Background
background.description: Canvas background color (shows in gutters and margins).

minCellPx.label: Min cell (px)
minCellPx.description: Smallest typical cell scale in px (readability floor). Default 120.

maxCellPx.label: Max cell (px)
maxCellPx.description: Largest typical cell scale in px. Default 320.

gutterPx.label: Gutter (px)
gutterPx.description: Explicit gutter in pixels (overrides Gutter; 0 = flush collage).

marginPx.label: Margin (px)
marginPx.description: Explicit outer margin in pixels (overrides Margin; must not exceed the gutter).

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract: verify per-image aspect, lattice gutters, coverage and equal-size classes; on violation render a LAYOUT_CONTRACT error mosaic and stamp editor.layoutContract. Deterministic default false.
